lessons_used: No kind of change has been shown to be helpful yet across 10 tests.
Finish new screen changes showed no clear effect across 3 tests.
Adoption redesign changes lean negative across 3 tests, with one stopped early due to worse adoption.
Evidence is still thin for adoption new screen, finish new flow, home redesign, and sign-in hint changes.
Positive predictions were generally too high.
Negative predictions were too low, as all tests with negative predictions measured positive or near-zero results.

candidates.title: Account Persistence Data Protection Note
candidates.change: Adds an explicit explanatory hint on the sign-in screen informing users that signing in prevents pet reset issues across sessions.
candidates.why: 8 support emails cited missing or reset pets after signing in again, and sign_in has a 72.9% completion rate.

sign_in.hint: Sign in with your primary account to save your pet permanently across app restarts.

guard.reason: The hint provides clear functionality guidance on the sign-in screen without violating any rules.

candidates.score_note: High support evidence regarding reset pets; low cost hint change.

candidates.title: Desktop Placement and Interaction Hub
candidates.change: Redesigns the final home intro screen into a split layout featuring quick interaction tips and desktop control shortcuts.
candidates.why: Finish step conversion drops to 64.8% with long completion times (395s median), and support reported 3 complaints on unclear pet controls.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Ready on Your Desktop!
home_intro.body: Learn how to interact, minimize, or summon your companion anytime.

components.text: Right-click pet for main interaction menu

guard.reason: Redesigning the home intro screen inside onboarding is allowed and preserves its introductory purpose.

candidates.score_note: Targets high finish drop-off, but requires UI redesign.

candidates.title: Pick Friend Compact Grid Selection
candidates.change: Redesigns the companion selection screen into a compact grid layout with step progress indicator.
candidates.why: Adoption step has the biggest drop (60.9% conversion) and long completion times (89s median / 1017s mean).

guard.reason: Grid redesign of the pick friend screen retains its core function of letting the user select a companion.

candidates.score_note: Highest funnel drop step, but adoption redesigns lean negative (-2.3%).

candidates.title: Pet Generation Time Notification Banner
candidates.change: Enables completion notification and estimated wait time display on the waiting screen with background completion guidance.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a 201s median / 2336s mean duration, and support received reports of app stalling.

waiting.hint: Your pet is generating in the background. Feel free to minimize this window.

guard.reason: Adding time estimates and background status to the waiting screen maintains the required waiting function without unfair design.

candidates.score_note: Strong support alignment on stalling during long wait times.

candidates.title: Story Screen Compact Overview
candidates.change: Reconfigures the intro story screen to a compact layout to streamline initial path onboarding.
candidates.why: The choose_path phase takes a high mean duration (514s), indicating drop-off friction during initial narrative presentation.

story.headline: Welcome to Your Desktop Companion
story.body: Select how you want to bring your digital companion to life.

guard.reason: Compact layout for the story screen introduces the pet and complies with onboarding redesign rules.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high initial duration, but lacks direct support complaints.

candidates.title: Pet Desktop Visibility Verification Step
candidates.change: Inserts a dedicated visibility check screen before home intro to ensure the pet renders properly on user desktops.
candidates.why: Support logged 3 issues regarding pets not rendering on desktop or app failing to display after setup.

new_visibility_check.headline: Can You See Your Pet on Screen?
new_visibility_check.body: If your pet is hidden under other windows, click below to bring it to the front.

guard.reason: Adding a new visibility check step inside onboarding before home intro is permitted.

candidates.score_note: New screens add friction; previous finish new screen tests showed minimal lift (+0.4%).

candidates.title: Custom Photo Quality Guidance Hint
candidates.change: Displays clear image quality upload recommendations directly on the photo upload screen.
candidates.why: Support received 3 reports of custom pet creation failing or looking distorted.

upload_photos.hint: For best results, upload bright, front-facing photos with clear background contrast.

candidates.title: Path Choice Instant Setup Tag
candidates.change: Adds an instant setup badge component to the path selection screen to encourage faster path commitment.
candidates.why: Choose path has a 76.2% conversion rate and a mean completion time of 514s.

guard.reason: Adding an instant setup badge component to choose path is a valid onboarding enhancement.

candidates.score_note: Low cost badge implementation, though funnel evidence is weak.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Centered Stage Layout
candidates.change: Updates adoption certificate display layout to centered mode with explicit progress tracking.
candidates.why: Adoption step drops to 60.9% conversion; a cleaner confirmation layout reduces hesitation prior to pet generation.

guard.reason: Updating layout and progress indicators on the adoption certificate preserves the screen's core purpose.

candidates.score_note: Targets largest funnel drop with minor layout adjustment rather than full redesign.

candidates.title: Sign In Account Stability Messaging
candidates.change: Updates sign in screen headline and body text to emphasize account data protection and pet persistence.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about lost or reset pets after re-authenticating.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Keep Your Pet Safe
sign_in.body: Creating your account locks in your pet choices and prevents progress loss across app updates.

guard.reason: Updating sign-in copy to emphasize data persistence is informative and compliant with fair design rules.

candidates.score_note: Config-only copy change directly addressing 8 support complaints.
